name: Venom Thread
description: Spin a fine thread of venom qi from the fingertip and loop it round a foe's ankle.

name: Needle Spray
description: Fire a short spray of venom needles in a narrow fan at the foe's torso.

name: Thread Parry
description: Cut an incoming strike aside with a taut venom thread strung across the forearm.

name: Venom Scent
description: Scent venom threads on the air to tell whether the foe or anything near them is toxic.

name: Needle Step
description: Step along a thread of qi pulled taut between two points and land at the far end.

name: Venom Weave
description: Weave threads over a hand and lash the foe, leaving thin lines of burning venom across the skin.

name: Threaded Cage
description: Spin threads into a loose cage round the foe's torso so every move strains the lines and stings.

name: Poison Palm
description: Strike with a palm that leaves a mark of toxin qi on the foe's chest.

name: Venom Elbow
description: Drive the elbow into the foe's flank and release a bite of venom qi on contact.

name: Barbed Palm
description: Hold up a palm wreathed in toxin qi so a punch coming in stings the knuckles.

name: Heel Sting
description: Kick with a heel coated in toxin qi to leave a wide stinging mark on the shin or thigh.

name: Marrow Venom
description: Press venom deep into the limb through a narrow strike so it reaches the bone.

name: Venom Rake
description: Rake the fingers across the foe's guard arm and leave four burning lines that make the arm tremble.

name: Toxic Veil
description: Throw a thin veil of toxic mist before the foe that stings the eyes and blurs the view.

name: Haze Step
description: Step behind a puff of haze and appear at the foe's side while their eyes smart.

name: Cloud Shell
description: Cloak the body in a thin cloud of poison qi that puts off a casual grab.

name: Vapor Sense
description: Taste the make-up of a mist in the air to learn which toxins it carries.

name: Fume Jet
description: Blow a jet of fume across a short arc to sting everyone before the user.

name: Drift Cloud
description: Let a low cloud of dulling qi drift over the foes and sap their pace.

name: Choking Veil
description: Thicken the veil into a choking shroud that tightens the foe's throat and slows their steps.

name: Veil Burst
description: Burst the cloud outward in a bright pulse that scalds the eyes and skin of all inside.

name: Purge Pulse
description: Pulse the body's qi outward to push thin toxins out through the skin.

name: Chill Sip
description: Sip cool qi along the throat of an ally to soothe a burning gullet.

name: Salve Wrap
description: Wrap an ally's cut hand in a sheet of salve qi to hold the edges closed.

name: Taint Sense
description: Find the dark spot of taint in an ally's blood by laying two fingers on the wrist.

name: Blood Purge
description: Draw venom out of an ally's blood along the arm and shed it from the fingertips as dark beads.

name: Antidote Flood
description: Flood a poisoned ally with counter qi that breaks the toxin into harmless motes.

name: Viper Bite
description: Strike with two fingers like a viper's fangs at the neck or wrist and inject venom qi.

name: Coil Guard
description: Coil the arms round the chest in a guard that stings anything pressing against it.

name: Asp Slip
description: Slip low and forward like an asp and rise inside the foe's reach.

name: Cobra Rise
description: Rise with the hand flared like a hood so the foe flinches and loses the line of attack.

name: Krait Flick
description: Flick a narrow banded bead of venom qi that strikes with a thin fast sting.

name: Double Fang
description: Strike twice in one beat with paired fingers and sink venom into two points on the foe.

name: Hood Spread
description: Spread the hands in a hood and sweep a blow wide, leaving the foe off balance and flinching.

name: Blight Root
description: Send toxin qi down through the sole to root a foe's foot in sour earth.

name: Sap Draw
description: Strike and draw a little of the foe's qi out through the contact like sap.

name: Leaf Screen
description: Spread broad leaves of toxin qi round the arms to take light blows.

name: Bitter Sprout
description: Flick a sprouting seed that takes root in the foe's skin and itches fiercely.

name: Tendril Lash
description: Lash thin tendrils of qi round a limb to hold it against the body.

name: Taproot Scent
description: Feel the deep roots of a blighted plant or body and read where the toxin runs strongest.

name: Blight Bloom
description: Open a bloom of sour spores in front of the user that scorches all who breathe it.

name: Strangle Vine
description: Grow a thick vine of toxin qi round the foe's legs that tightens with each struggle.

name: Mold Ward
description: Raise a ring of mold qi that rots the edges of weapons striking it.

name: Wasting Dose
description: Touch the foe and leave a dose that saps the strength from the arm over many breaths.

name: Bitter Draught
description: Brew a draught of bitter qi in the belly that tempers the user's endurance.

name: Draught Ward
description: Blunt a toxin's bite by drawing counter qi through the blood before it settles.

name: Dry Breath
description: Breathe out a dry exhale that saps the foe's breath and leaves the chest hollow.

name: Withering Touch
description: Lay a hand on the foe's shoulder and wither the muscle beneath with draining toxin.

name: Fading Draught
description: Feed an ally a draught of fading qi that melts a lingering poison out of the blood.
